segments.segment_summary: A POV shot from inside a combine harvester at night, showing the machine cutting through and processing rows of corn. A tractor with a grain cart drives alongside to collect the harvested grain before the combine finishes the field.

key_moments.caption: The combine harvester moves through a cornfield at night, its headlights illuminating the dry stalks as they are pulled into the machine.
The camera pans to the left, showing harvested corn being augered from the combine into a red grain cart pulled by an adjacent tractor.
The view returns to the front as the combine continues down the rows, with a digital display on the right showing a yield map.
The combine reaches the end of the corn rows and finishes harvesting the last of the stalks.

segments.segment_summary: The driver turns the camera to face himself inside the dark cab and gives a summary of the harvest statistics, including the acreage, yield, and moisture content of the corn just harvested.

key_moments.caption: The driver turns to face the camera inside the dark cab of the combine.
He reports finishing the cornfield and states the average yield was 224.
He states the average moisture content of the corn was 18.3 percent.
He concludes by giving the total dry and wet bushel numbers for the completed harvest.
